app.title: SuperImage — AI Image Generation
app.description: Generate stunning images from text with AI
hero.title: SuperImage
hero.desc: Generate stunning images from text. Powered by GPT‑Image‑1. Lossless quality. Privacy first. Open source.
feature.losslessDesc: Images are stored as raw PNGs in your browser — no compression, no quality loss. What the AI generates is exactly what you get.
feature.chatDesc: Generate images through natural conversation. Each session keeps full history with prompts, parameters, and results.
feature.privacyDesc: Your API key and images stay in your browser. Nothing is sent to our servers — the app talks directly to the AI provider.
feature.flexibleDesc: Switch sizes, quality presets, and batch count on the fly. Supports custom API endpoints and multiple models.
footer.text: SuperImage © {year} — Built with Next.js, Ant Design, and OpenAI
